name: Gas injection and WAG (hydrocarbon, CO2, nitrogen)
aliases: Gas injection and WAG (hydrocarbon, CO2, nitrogen)
principle: Gas (natural gas, nitrogen or CO2) is injected to maintain pressure or become miscible with oil; water-alternating-gas (WAG) cycles gas and water to improve sweep. Gas injection projects made up 56% of the 374 EOR projects counted worldwide in 2017 (CO2 44%, other gas 12%).

process_steps.name: Inject gas or alternate gas and water

performance.metric: share of 2017 EOR projects using CO2

source.note: Wikipedia, Enhanced oil recovery, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

performance.basis: depth threshold for miscible CO2 flooding as stated in the source
